name: Settings
description: Sanitized config summary (student profile, subjects, learning policy, practice defaults, export policy, no secrets) plus the two authored aggregate metrics that cannot be recomputed from the current record lists (mastery_score, questions_analyzed — an all-time history, not just currently open items). {target}
